title: Kissed Creamy Argentinian Chinese Long Beans Gratin
description: A funky and indulgent Argentinian dish featuring Chinese long beans, with a Mediterranean twist, broiled to perfection in a creamy sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the Chinese long beans for 4 minutes.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the garlic and onion until softened.
In a separate saucepan, combine the heavy cream and grated Parmesan cheese, and stir over low heat until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange the blanched Chinese long beans in a single layer.
Pour the cream sauce over the long beans and sprinkle with chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Broil the gratin in the preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
